title: Sit, Stand, Walk, Fall: A State Machine That Moves Between Them Only When It Is Safe, and Refuses When It Is Not

artifact.note: the modes of a quadruped as a state machine: sitting, rising, standing, walking, lowering (sitting down), fallen and faulted; what the operator wants (sit, stand or walk) and what the robot checks before it goes along with it (the battery, the temperature of the knees as a fraction of their limit, the link, whether it has fallen); transitions that wait for the legs to have finished (the stand reached, the sit reached, the walk slowed to a stop before it is stopped), a time limit on every move, a limited number of tries at getting up, and a fault that stays until it is reset; tested through a normal day and through each way it can go wrong
